scene_summary: A soft-edged color-field painting on cream, aged canvas, with a pink L-form, a green oval with an ochre core, and a mottled cobalt cloud in the upper half. A full-width row of alternating cobalt and crimson bead-dabs divides the field, above a rose-pink lower wash holding a cobalt hourglass form flanked by turquoise glows.
usable_surfaces: green oval with ochre core upper center

detected_objects.label: Full-width horizon row of alternating cobalt and crimson bead-dabs
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A continuous horizontal row of about 22 soft, evenly spaced oval dabs alternates cobalt blue and crimson red. It runs edge to edge at about 51-56% of the image height and divides the cream upper field from the pink lower wash. This matches the planned anchor.
